hindi: मध्यम राजा का स्वयं, तीसरी और पाँचवीं प्रकृतियाँ हैं।
english: The middle king's self, the third and the fifth [are] constituent elements (prakṛti).

text_flags.why: possible stray or doubled word before prakṛtayaḥ; it has no function in the sentence

notes: The 'prakṛtī' before 'prakṛtayaḥ' is left untranslated as a probable slip (dittography or prakṛtiḥ). 'Middle king's self, third and fifth' are counted in the sequence of the circle, with the middle king as the first; the text does not say this. Copula supplied.
lines_deva: मध्यमस्य-आत्मा तृतीया पञ्चमी च प्रकृती प्रकृतयः
lines_iast: madhyamasya-ātmā tṛtīyā pañcamī ca prakṛtī prakṛtayaḥ

hindi: दूसरी, चौथी और छठी विकृतियाँ हैं।
english: The second, the fourth and the sixth [are] modifications (vikṛti).
notes: vikṛti ('alteration, modification') kept literal, no technical sense imported. Copula supplied.
lines_deva: द्वितीया चतुर्थी षष्ठी च विकृतयः
lines_iast: dvitīyā caturthī ṣaṣṭhī ca vikṛtayaḥ

hindi: यदि मध्यम राजा उन दोनों पर अनुग्रह करे, विजिगीषु मध्यम राजा के अनुकूल रहे।
english: If the middle king should favour both of those, the conqueror should be conformable to the middle king.
notes: 'tat ubhayam' are in apposition ('that, both'); rendered 'both of those', referring to the two sets of units 1-2. anuloma = 'with the grain', conformable.
lines_deva: तच् चेद् उभयं मध्यमो ऽनुगृह्णीयात्, विजिगीषुर् मध्यम.अनुलोमः स्यात्
lines_iast: tac ced ubhayaṃ madhyamo 'nugṛhṇīyāt, vijigīṣur madhyama.anulomaḥ syāt

hindi: यदि अनुग्रह न करे, प्रकृतियों के अनुकूल रहे।
english: If [he] should not favour [them], [the conqueror] should be conformable to the constituent elements.
notes: Subjects are not stated; supplied in brackets in English only.
lines_deva: न चेद् अनुगृह्णीयात्, प्रकृत्य्.अनुलोमः स्यात्
lines_iast: na ced anugṛhṇīyāt, prakṛty.anulomaḥ syāt

hindi: यदि मध्यम राजा विजिगीषु के मित्र को, मित्रभावी को, पाना चाहे, मित्र के और अपने मित्रों को उठाकर और मध्यम राजा से मित्रों को फोड़कर मित्र की रक्षा करे।
english: If the middle king should wish to obtain the conqueror's ally, an ally-natured [one], [the conqueror], having raised up the allies of the ally and of himself and having split the allies away from the middle king, should protect the ally.

text_flags.why: h missing: madyama is not a word

notes: mitra-bhāvin: 'having the nature of an ally' (alternative: 'about to become an ally'); medium. 'ātmanaḥ' = of himself, i.e. of the conqueror (the subject of trāyeta).
lines_deva: मद्यमश् चेद् विजिगीषोर् मित्रं मित्र.भावि लिप्सेत, मित्रस्य-आत्मनश् च मित्राण्य् उत्थाप्य मध्यमाच् च मित्राणि भेदयित्वा मित्रं त्रायेत
lines_iast: madyamaś ced vijigīṣor mitraṃ mitra.bhāvi lipseta, mitrasya-ātmanaś ca mitrāṇy utthāpya madhyamāc ca mitrāṇi bhedayitvā mitraṃ trāyeta

hindi: या मण्डल को उभारे: “यह मध्यम अत्यन्त बढ़ा हुआ है, हम सबके विनाश के लिए उठ खड़ा हुआ है, मिलकर इसकी यात्रा को विफल करें।”
english: Or [the conqueror] should rouse the circle: "This middle king, excessively grown, has risen up for the destruction of all of us; having come together, let us thwart his march."
notes: protsāhayet read pra-utsāhayet (utsāhayati = rouse, glossary 13.1). 'vihanāma' is a 1 pl. form of vi-√han, taken as 'let us thwart' (alternative 'we would strike down'); medium. The closing iti only closes the quotation.
lines_deva: मण्डलं वा प्रोत्साहयेत् "अतिप्रवृद्धो ऽयं मध्यमः सर्वेषां नो विनाशाय-अभ्युत्थितः, सम्भूय-अस्य यात्रां विहनाम" इति
lines_iast: maṇḍalaṃ vā protsāhayet "atipravṛddho 'yaṃ madhyamaḥ sarveṣāṃ no vināśāya-abhyutthitaḥ, sambhūya-asya yātrāṃ vihanāma" iti

words.gloss: by restraint of the middle king

hindi: यदि मण्डल उसका अनुग्रह करे, मध्यम राजा को रोकने से अपने को बढ़ाए।
english: If the circle should favour that, [the conqueror] should strengthen himself by restraint of the middle king.
notes: avagraha = restraint (glossary 7.5); the genitive relation (objective) is read 'restraining the middle king'. 'tat' = the proposal of the preceding unit; subject of upabṛṃhayet supplied.
lines_deva: तच् चेन् मण्डलम् अनुगृह्णीयात्, मध्यम.अवग्रहेण-आत्मानम् उपबृंहयेत्
lines_iast: tac cen maṇḍalam anugṛhṇīyāt, madhyama.avagraheṇa-ātmānam upabṛṃhayet

hindi: यदि अनुग्रह न करे, कोश और सेना से मित्र पर अनुग्रह करके, मध्यम राजा से द्वेष रखने वाले जो राजा या परस्पर अनुगृहीत होकर अनेक ठहरें, या एक की सिद्धि होने पर अनेक सिद्ध हों, या परस्पर से शंकित होकर न उठें, उनमें से एक प्रधान को या निकट को साम और दान से प्राप्त करे।
english: If [the circle] should not favour [that], having favoured the ally with treasury and army, [the conqueror] should obtain, by conciliation and gifts, one chief or a near [one] of those kings who hate the middle king, who, either mutually favoured, might stand many, or upon the success of one many might succeed, or, suspicious of one another, might not rise up.
notes: Segmentation of the long sentence is by the punctuation of the e-text. 'tiṣṭheyuḥ' = might stand (remain); 'eka-siddhau' = upon the success of one. 'pradhānam ekam āsannaṃ vā': one chief, or a near one (noun not stated). The subject of the first clause is supplied from unit 7 (the circle). sāma = conciliation, dāna = gifts (glossary 12.1).
lines_deva: न चेद् अनुगृह्णीयात्, कोश.दण्डाभ्यां मित्रम् अनुगृह्य ये मध्यम.द्वेषिणो राजानः परस्पर.अनुगृहीता वा बहवस् तिष्ठेयुः, एक.सिद्धौ वा बहवः सिध्येयुः, परस्पराद् वा शङ्किता न-उत्तिष्ठेरन्, तेषां प्रधानम् एकम् आसन्नं वा साम.दानाभ्यां लभेत
lines_iast: na ced anugṛhṇīyāt, kośa.daṇḍābhyāṃ mitram anugṛhya ye madhyama.dveṣiṇo rājānaḥ paraspara.anugṛhītā vā bahavas tiṣṭheyuḥ, eka.siddhau vā bahavaḥ sidhyeyuḥ, parasparād vā śaṅkitā na-uttiṣṭheran, teṣāṃ pradhānam ekam āsannaṃ vā sāma.dānābhyāṃ labheta

hindi: दो गुण वाला दूसरे को, तीन गुण वाला तीसरे को।
english: Having two guṇas, [he should obtain] the second; having three guṇas, the third.
notes: Verb understood from the preceding unit (labheta); the sense of guṇa here (e.g. twice/thrice as much of treasury and army, or qualities) is not stated; guṇa kept. 'second' and 'third' are not further specified (presumably the second and third of those kings).
lines_deva: द्वि.गुणो द्वितीयं त्रि.गुनस् तृतीयम्
lines_iast: dvi.guṇo dvitīyaṃ tri.gunas tṛtīyam

hindi: इस प्रकार संचित किया हुआ, मध्यम राजा को रोके।
english: In this way heaped up, [the conqueror] should restrain the middle king.
notes: abhyuccita (abhi-ud-√ci, 'heaped up, increased') is taken as 'built up' (strengthened); subject supplied. Alternative: 'raised'.
lines_deva: एवम् अभ्युच्चितो मध्यमम् अवगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: evam abhyuccito madhyamam avagṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: in the lapse of place and time

hindi: या देश और काल का अतिक्रमण होने पर मध्यम राजा से सन्धि करके मित्र की सहायता करे, या दूष्यों में कर्म-सन्धि करे।
english: Or, when place and time lapse, having made peace with the middle king, [the conqueror] should render assistance to the ally; or [should make] a treaty of works (karma-sandhi) among the treasonable.
notes: sandhāya = having made peace (glossary 7.4); karma-sandhi, a named kind, = treaty (7.3, 12.1). atipatti = passing beyond, lapse; the sense (missing the time and place for action) not stated. sācivya = assistance (literally 'help as of a minister'). 'kuryāt' with sācivyam: 'should do/render'. 'dūṣyeṣu vā karma-sandhim': verb supplied; 'among the treasonable' is literal locative.
lines_deva: देश.काल.अतिपत्तौ वा सन्धाय मध्यमेन मित्रस्य साचिव्यं कुर्यात्, दूष्येषु वा कर्म.सन्धिम्
lines_iast: deśa.kāla.atipattau vā sandhāya madhyamena mitrasya sācivyaṃ kuryāt, dūṣyeṣu vā karma.sandhim

hindi: या इसके मित्र को, जिसे क्षीण करना है, मध्यम पाना चाहे, इसे क्षीण करने तक रोके: “मैं तुम्हारी रक्षा करूँ।”
english: Or, if the middle king should wish to obtain his ally who is to be weakened, [the conqueror] should hold him back until the weakening: "I would protect you."
notes: asya = of the conqueror; 'enam' (him) may be the ally or the middle king: the text does not say; 'until the weakening' (ā + ablative) read as up to the weakening of the ally. The closing iti only closes the quotation.
lines_deva: कर्शनीयं वा-अस्य मित्रं मध्यमो लिप्सेत, प्रतिस्तम्भयेद् एनं "अहं त्वा त्रायेय" इति आ कर्शनात्
lines_iast: karśanīyaṃ vā-asya mitraṃ madhyamo lipseta, pratistambhayed enaṃ "ahaṃ tvā trāyeya" iti ā karśanāt

hindi: क्षीण किए गए इसकी रक्षा करे।
english: [The conqueror] should protect him, weakened.
notes: Subject supplied in English only.
lines_deva: कर्शितम् एनं त्रायेत
lines_iast: karśitam enaṃ trāyeta

words.gloss: from fear of the growth of the middle king

hindi: या इसके मित्र को, जिसका उच्छेद करना है, मध्यम पाना चाहे, क्षीण किए गए इसकी मध्यम की वृद्धि के भय से रक्षा करे।
english: Or, if the middle king should wish to obtain his ally who is to be uprooted, [the conqueror] should protect him, weakened, from fear of the growth of the middle king.
notes: vṛddhi = growth. 'karśitam enam' as in unit 13.
lines_deva: उच्छेदनीयं वा-अस्य मित्रं मध्यमो लिप्सेत, कर्शितम् एनं त्रायेत मध्यम.वृद्धि.भयात्
lines_iast: ucchedanīyaṃ vā-asya mitraṃ madhyamo lipseta, karśitam enaṃ trāyeta madhyama.vṛddhi.bhayāt

hindi: या उच्छिन्न को भूमि के अनुग्रह से हाथ में कर ले, अन्यत्र हट जाने के भय से।
english: Or [the conqueror] should take him, uprooted, in hand by the favour of land, from fear of [his] retreat elsewhere.
notes: 'haste kuryāt' = literally 'should put in the hand' (take in hand, bring under control); medium. 'ucchinnam' refers to the ally of unit 14. apasāra = retreat here (the 10.2 sense 'place of retreat' is also possible); 'anyatra-apasāra-bhayāt' is read as anyatra + apasāra-bhaya, the e-text '-' joining two words.
lines_deva: उच्छिन्नं वा भूम्य्.अनुग्रहेण हस्ते कुर्याद् अन्यत्र-अपसार.भयात्
lines_iast: ucchinnaṃ vā bhūmy.anugraheṇa haste kuryād anyatra-apasāra.bhayāt

words.gloss: of the one to be weakened and the one to be uprooted

hindi: यदि क्षीण करने योग्य और उच्छेद करने योग्य के मित्र मध्यम राजा की सहायता करने वाले हों, दूसरे पुरुष के द्वारा सन्धि की जाए।
english: If the allies of the one to be weakened and the one to be uprooted should be givers of assistance of the middle king, peace should be made through another man.
notes: 'allies of the two' read with the genitive dual, and the two taken as the persons of units 12 and 14 (whose ally is wanted by the middle king); the text does not say whose allies exactly. sandhīyeta passive: 'peace should be made' (sandhi = peace, glossary 7.4). puruṣa-antara = 'another man' (also a named kind of treaty, 7.3); medium.
lines_deva: कर्शनीय.उच्छेदनीययोश् चेन् मित्राणि मध्यमस्य साचिव्य.कराणि स्युः, पुरुष.अन्तरेण सन्धीयेत
lines_iast: karśanīya.ucchedanīyayoś cen mitrāṇi madhyamasya sācivya.karāṇi syuḥ, puruṣa.antareṇa sandhīyeta

hindi: विजिगीषु के या उन दोनों के मित्र रोकने में समर्थ हों, सन्धि को प्राप्त हो।
english: [If] the allies of the conqueror or of those two should be capable of restraint, [the conqueror] should enter into peace.
notes: avagraha = restraint (of the middle king, not stated). 'tayoḥ' = the two of unit 16. Subject of upeyāt supplied.
lines_deva: विजिगीषोर् वा तयोर् मित्राण्य् अवग्रह.समर्थानि स्युः, सन्धिम् उपेयात्
lines_iast: vijigīṣor vā tayor mitrāṇy avagraha.samarthāni syuḥ, sandhim upeyāt

hindi: या इसके शत्रु को मध्यम पाना चाहे, सन्धि को प्राप्त हो।
english: Or, if the middle king should wish to obtain his enemy, [the conqueror] should enter into peace.
notes: 'asya' = of the conqueror; subject of upeyāt supplied. sandhi = peace as in 7.4.
lines_deva: अमित्रं वा-अस्य मध्यमो लिप्सेत, सन्धिम् उपेयात्
lines_iast: amitraṃ vā-asya madhyamo lipseta, sandhim upeyāt

hindi: इस प्रकार अपना प्रयोजन और मध्यम राजा का प्रिय किया हुआ होता है।
english: In this way both one's own interest and what is dear to the middle king are done.
notes: artha in sva-artha = interest (glossary 5.6). kṛtaḥ is masculine singular agreeing with sva-arthaḥ; priyam is neuter, so 'are done' covers both. 'ca ... ca' = both ... and (7.5).
lines_deva: एवं स्व.अर्थश् च कृतो भवति मध्यमस्य प्रियं च
lines_iast: evaṃ sva.arthaś ca kṛto bhavati madhyamasya priyaṃ ca

hindi: यदि मध्यम राजा अपने मित्र को, मित्रभावी को, पाना चाहे, दूसरे पुरुष के द्वारा सन्धि करे।
english: If the middle king should wish to obtain [the conqueror's] own ally, an ally-natured [one], [the conqueror] should make peace through another man.
notes: 'sva' = the conqueror's own (subject of sandadhyāt); bracketed in English. mitra-bhāvin as in unit 5. Object of sandadhyāt not stated (peace).
lines_deva: मध्यमश् चेत् स्व.मित्रं मित्र.भावि लिप्सेत, पुरुष.अन्तरेण सन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: madhyamaś cet sva.mitraṃ mitra.bhāvi lipseta, puruṣa.antareṇa sandadhyāt

hindi: या अपेक्षा सहित रोके: “तुम मित्र का उच्छेद करने के योग्य नहीं हो।”
english: Or [the conqueror] should restrain [him] with regard: "You ought not to uproot the ally."
notes: sa-apekṣam = 'with regard / with expectation' (alternative 'considerately'); medium. The person addressed is the middle king (unit 20). The closing iti only closes the quotation.
lines_deva: स.अपेक्षं वा "न-अर्हसि मित्रम् उच्छेत्तुम्" इति वारयेत्
lines_iast: sa.apekṣaṃ vā "na-arhasi mitram ucchettum" iti vārayet

words.gloss: because of the killing of its own party

hindi: या उपेक्षा करे: “इसका मण्डल अपने पक्ष के वध से कुपित हो।”
english: Or [the conqueror] should disregard [it]: "Let his circle be angry because of the killing of its own party."
notes: asya = of this one (the middle king); sva = its own. The closing iti only closes the quotation. pakṣa = party (side).
lines_deva: उपेक्षेत वा "मण्डलम् अस्य कुप्यतु स्व.पक्ष.वधात्" इति
lines_iast: upekṣeta vā "maṇḍalam asya kupyatu sva.pakṣa.vadhāt" iti

words.gram: m. nom. sg. (pres. pass. part. a-√dṛś)

hindi: या अपने शत्रु को मध्यम पाना चाहे, कोश और सेना से इसका, दिखाई न देता हुआ, अनुग्रह करे।
english: Or, if the middle king should wish to obtain an enemy of [the conqueror's] own, [the conqueror], not being seen, should favour him with treasury and army.
notes: 'ātmanaḥ' = of himself (the conqueror); 'enam' (him) is probably the enemy but could be the middle king: the text does not say; medium/low. Subject of anugṛhṇīyāt supplied.
lines_deva: अमित्रम् आत्मनो वा मध्यमो लिप्सेत, कोश.दण्डाभ्याम् एनम् अदृश्यमानो ऽनुगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: amitram ātmano vā madhyamo lipseta, kośa.daṇḍābhyām enam adṛśyamāno 'nugṛhṇīyāt

hindi: या उदासीन को मध्यम पाना चाहे, इसे सहायता दे: “उदासीन से अलग हो जाए।”
english: Or, if the middle king should wish to obtain the neutral king, [the conqueror] should give help to him: "Let [him] be split from the neutral king."
notes: 'asmai' (to this one) and the subject of 'bhidyatām' are not stated: probably the middle king is given help and told to split from the neutral king, but another reading is possible; medium/low. The closing iti only closes the quotation.
lines_deva: उदासीनं वा मध्यमो लिप्सेत, अस्मै साहाय्यं दद्याद् "उदासीनाद् भिद्यताम्" इति
lines_iast: udāsīnaṃ vā madhyamo lipseta, asmai sāhāyyaṃ dadyād "udāsīnād bhidyatām" iti

words.gloss: of the middle king and the neutral king

hindi: मध्यम और उदासीन में जो मण्डल को अभिप्रेत हो, उसका आश्रय ले।
english: Of the middle king and the neutral king, [the conqueror] should resort to whichever is desired by the circle.
notes: abhipreta = intended, approved (liked by the circle); āśraya = resort (glossary 7.2). Subject supplied.
lines_deva: मध्यम.उदासीनयोर् यो मण्डलस्य-अभिप्रेतस् तम् आश्रयेत
lines_iast: madhyama.udāsīnayor yo maṇḍalasya-abhipretas tam āśrayeta

words.gloss: by the conduct of the middle king

hindi: मध्यम राजा के आचरण से उदासीन के आचरण की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By the conduct of the middle king, the conduct of the neutral king is explained.
notes: Follows the formula 'By that, X is explained' (glossary 4.1).
lines_deva: मध्यम.चरितेन-उदासीन.चरितं व्याख्यातम्
lines_iast: madhyama.caritena-udāsīna.caritaṃ vyākhyātam

hindi: यदि उदासीन मध्यम को पाना चाहे, जिससे शत्रु को छल ले, मित्र का उपकार करे या सेना से उपकार करने वाले उदासीन को पाए, उसकी ओर मुड़े।
english: If the neutral king should wish to obtain the middle king, [the conqueror] should turn to that [side] from which he might outwit the enemy, do help for the ally, or obtain a neutral king giving help with the army.
notes: Subject of the main clause is supplied (the conqueror); 'yataḥ ... tataḥ' = from which ... from that. pariṇameta (pari-√nam) = 'should turn, change over'; medium/low. atisandadhyāt = outwit (glossary 9.1, 9.3); daṇḍa = army; upakāra = help.
lines_deva: उदासीनश् चेन् मध्यमं लिप्सेत, यतः शत्रुम् अतिसन्दध्यान् मित्रस्य-उपकारं कुर्याद् उदासीनं वा दण्ड.उपकारिणं लभेत ततः परिणमेत
lines_iast: udāsīnaś cen madhyamaṃ lipseta, yataḥ śatrum atisandadhyān mitrasya-upakāraṃ kuryād udāsīnaṃ vā daṇḍa.upakāriṇaṃ labheta tataḥ pariṇameta

hindi: इस प्रकार अपने को बढ़ाकर शत्रु-प्रकृति को क्षीण करे और मित्र-प्रकृति को सहारा दे।
english: Having strengthened himself in this way, [the conqueror] should weaken the enemy constituent element and support the ally constituent element.

text_flags.why: possible missing anusvāra (cf. upabṛṃhayet in unit 7)

notes: ari-prakṛti / mitra-prakṛti: 'the enemy / ally element' (prakṛti = constituent element), singular, as printed; the plural of the circle may be meant.
lines_deva: एवम् उपबृह्य-आत्मानम् अरि.प्रकृतिं कर्शयेन् मित्र.प्रकृतिं च-उपगृह्णीयात्
lines_iast: evam upabṛhya-ātmānam ari.prakṛtiṃ karśayen mitra.prakṛtiṃ ca-upagṛhṇīyāt

words.gloss: in the state of being an enemy
the one to be marched against
set out with the same aim
set out with a separate aim
set out with his own aim

hindi: उसके शत्रु-भाव के होने पर भी: अनात्मवान्, नित्य अपकार करने वाला, शत्रु, शत्रु से संहित या पार्ष्णि-ग्राह; व्यसन वाला, जिस पर चढ़ाई करनी है; या व्यसन में नेता का आक्रमणकारी — ये शत्रुभावी हैं। एक प्रयोजन से चल पड़ा हुआ, अलग प्रयोजन से चल पड़ा हुआ, मिलकर यात्रा करने वाला, संहित होकर प्रयाण करने वाला, अपने प्रयोजन से चल पड़ा हुआ, साथ उठ खड़ा होने वाला साथी, कोश और सेना में से किसी एक का क्रेता या विक्रेता, द्वैधीभाव वाला — ये मित्रभावी हैं। सामन्त: बलवान् का प्रतिघात करने वाला, अन्तर्धि, या बलवान् का पड़ोसी, या बलवान् का पार्ष्णि-ग्राह, अपने आप समर्पण करने वाला, प्रताप से समर्पण करने वाला, या सेना सहित समर्पण करने वाला — ये सामन्त भृत्यभावी हैं।
english: Even when there is, of him, the state of being an enemy: [one] not self-possessed, constantly harming, an enemy, allied with an enemy, or a heel-seizer; in calamity, the one to be marched against; or, in calamity, an attacker of the leader — such are the enemy-natured. Set out with the same aim, set out with a separate aim, marching in combination, marching allied, set out with his own aim, an associate in the rising, a buyer or seller of either treasury or army, one of the dual policy — such are the ally-natured. A neighbouring chief [who is] a repeller of a strong one, an antardhi, or a neighbour of a strong one, or a heel-seizer of a strong one, one who has submitted of himself, one submitted through splendour, or one submitted with his army — such neighbouring chiefs are servant-natured.
notes: GROUPING: the unit is one sentence over two printed lines; the lone '-' at the end of line 1 is the e-text's continuation mark (the sentence continues with 'sāmantaḥ'). The e-text prints no commas within the lists, so the list segmentation is a reading: the first list is read as (1) anātmavān nitya-apakārī śatruḥ, (2) śatru-saṃhitaḥ pārṣṇi-grāho vā, (3) vyasanī yātavyaḥ, (4) vyasane vā netur abhiyoktā; alternatives are possible. 'tasya' (of him) is not identified. -bhāvin = 'having the nature of' (alternative 'likely to become'); medium. 'daṇḍa-upanata' = submitted with his army (glossary 12.5), 'pratāpa' = splendour (7.4), 'antardhi' kept untranslated (7.2), 'sāmutthāyika' = associate in the rising (8.2), dvaidhī-bhāva = dual policy. The English 'one' before participles is a natural-English carrier of the -a nominative. Reviewer: -bhāvin aligned with 7.9 (ally-natured / मित्रभावी); the earlier note giving 'having the nature of' is superseded.
lines_deva: सत्य् अप्य् अमित्र.भावे तस्य-अनात्मवान् नित्य.अपकारी शत्रुः शत्रु.संहितः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो वा व्यसनी यातव्यो व्यसने वा नेतुर् अभियोक्ता इत्य् अरि.भाविनः, एक.अर्थ.अभिप्रयातः पृथग्.अर्थ.अभिप्रयातः सम्भूय.यात्रिकः संहित.प्रयाणिकः स्व.अर्थ.अभिप्रयातः सामुत्थायिकः कोश.दण्डयोर् अन्यतरस्य क्रेता विक्रेता वा द्वैधी.भाविक इति मित्र.भाविनः, -
सामन्तो बलवतः प्रतिघातो ऽन्तर्धिः प्रतिवेशो वा बलवतः पार्ष्णि.ग्राहो वा स्वयम् उपनतः प्रताप.उपनतो वा दण्ड.उपनत इति भृत्य.भाविनः सामन्ताः
lines_iast: saty apy amitra.bhāve tasya-anātmavān nitya.apakārī śatruḥ śatru.saṃhitaḥ pārṣṇi.grāho vā vyasanī yātavyo vyasane vā netur abhiyoktā ity ari.bhāvinaḥ, eka.artha.abhiprayātaḥ pṛthag.artha.abhiprayātaḥ sambhūya.yātrikaḥ saṃhita.prayāṇikaḥ sva.artha.abhiprayātaḥ sāmutthāyikaḥ kośa.daṇḍayor anyatarasya kretā vikretā vā dvaidhī.bhāvika iti mitra.bhāvinaḥ, -
sāmanto balavataḥ pratighāto 'ntardhiḥ prativeśo vā balavataḥ pārṣṇi.grāho vā svayam upanataḥ pratāpa.upanato vā daṇḍa.upanata iti bhṛtya.bhāvinaḥ sāmantāḥ

hindi: उनसे एक भूमि के अन्तर वालों की व्याख्या की गई।
english: By those, [the kings] with one land between are explained.
notes: Formula 'By that, X are explained'. 'bhūmi-eka-antarāḥ' = literally 'having one land in between'; the kings whose territory is separated by one land, not said in the unit. 'taiḥ' = by those (the neighbouring chiefs of unit 29).
lines_deva: तैर् भूम्य्.एक.अन्तरा व्याख्याताः
lines_iast: tair bhūmy.eka.antarā vyākhyātāḥ

hindi: उनमें से जो मित्र शत्रु के विरोध में एकप्रयोजनता को पहुँचे, उसका उस शक्ति से अनुग्रह करे जिससे दूसरे को सह सके।
english: Of those, the ally that should go to oneness of aim in opposition to the enemy, [the conqueror] should favour with the power by which [it] could withstand the other.

text_flags.why: possible stray dot: tad is the pronoun, a separate word from the verb

notes: 'param' = the other (the enemy); the subject of 'viṣaheta' is the ally. 'śaktyā' = by power (śakti). 'tad.anugṛhṇīyād' is the pronoun tat plus the verb, read as two words (the dot is taken as a slip, flagged). 'teṣām' = of those (the neighbouring chiefs and the one with one land between).
lines_deva: तेषां शत्रु.विरोधे यन् मित्रम् एक.अर्थतां व्रजेत्
शक्त्या तद्.अनुगृह्णीयाद् विषहेत यया परम्
lines_iast: teṣāṃ śatru.virodhe yan mitram eka.arthatāṃ vrajet
śaktyā tad.anugṛhṇīyād viṣaheta yayā param

words.gloss: state of not being under control
by the neighbouring chief and the one with one between

hindi: शत्रु को वश में करके जो मित्र बढ़कर वश में न रहने की स्थिति को पहुँचे, उसे सामन्त और एक के अन्तर वाले, उसकी दो प्रकृतियों, के द्वारा विरुद्ध करे।
english: Having subdued the enemy, [the conqueror] should set at odds, by the neighbouring chief and the [one] with one [land] between, its two constituent elements, that ally which, grown, should go to the state of not being under control.
notes: 'tat-prakṛtibhyām' is taken as an instrument qualifying the two persons ('who are its constituent elements', i.e. belonging to that ally's circle); the text does not say; low. 'vaśya' = under control, avaśyatā = state of not being under control. 'ekāntara' = with one (land) between, as in unit 30.
lines_deva: प्रसाध्य शत्रुं यन् मित्रं वृद्धं गच्छेद् अवश्यताम्
सामन्त.एक.अन्तराभ्यां तत्.प्रकृतिभ्यां विरोधयेत्
lines_iast: prasādhya śatruṃ yan mitraṃ vṛddhaṃ gacched avaśyatām
sāmanta.eka.antarābhyāṃ tat.prakṛtibhyāṃ virodhayet

words.gloss: by a member of his family and a prince in disfavour
should cause to be taken away

hindi: या तत्कुलीन और अपरुद्ध के द्वारा उसकी भूमि हरण करवाए, या जैसे अनुग्रह की अपेक्षा वाला वश में रहे वैसा आचरण करे।
english: Or [the conqueror] should have his land taken away by a member of his family and a prince in disfavour; or he should act so that, looking for favour, [he] would remain under control.
notes: 'tasya' = of that ally (unit 32). The 'vā' of line 1 is rendered as the opening 'or' of the unit and the 'vā' of line 2 as 'or'. 'anugraha-apekṣam vaśyam' are neuter/accusative-looking forms read adverbially; medium. tat-kulīna = member of his family, aparuddha = prince in disfavour (12.3). Reviewer: anugraha-apekṣam and vaśyam are read as neuter nominatives agreeing with mitram understood from unit 32, not as adverbs.
lines_deva: तत्.कुलीन.अपरुद्धाभ्यां भूमिं वा तस्य हारयेत्
यथा वा-अनुग्रह.अपेक्षं वश्यं तिष्ठेत् तथा चरेत्
lines_iast: tat.kulīna.aparuddhābhyāṃ bhūmiṃ vā tasya hārayet
yathā vā-anugraha.apekṣaṃ vaśyaṃ tiṣṭhet tathā caret

hindi: जो अत्यन्त क्षीण किया हुआ न उपकार करे या शत्रु के पास चला जाए, उस मित्र को अर्थ का ज्ञाता न घटा हुआ और न बढ़ा हुआ रखे।
english: [The ally] which, overly weakened, would not help or would go to the enemy — that ally one who knows artha should keep undiminished and ungrown.
notes: 'artha-vit' = knower of artha (literally; 'gain', 'wealth', 'interest' possible), rendered 'one who knows his interest'; medium. The ally is the object 'mitram' of line 2; 'yat' of line 1 refers to it. Reviewer: arthavit rendered 'one who knows artha' (interest, gain or wealth all possible); 'his interest' was dropped.
lines_deva: न-उपकुर्याद् अमित्रं वा गच्छेद् यद् अतिकर्शितम्
तद् अहीनम् अवृद्धं च स्थापयेन् मित्रम् अर्थवित्
lines_iast: na-upakuryād amitraṃ vā gacched yad atikarśitam
tad ahīnam avṛddhaṃ ca sthāpayen mitram arthavit

hindi: जो चञ्चल मित्र अर्थ की युक्ति से सन्धि को प्राप्त होता है, उसके चले जाने के कारण को नष्ट करे, जिससे न डिगे।
english: The wavering ally that comes to peace through a device of interest — [the conqueror] should destroy the cause of its going away, so that [it] would not waver.
notes: artha-yukti = 'device of interest' (yukti = device, glossary 15.1; artha could be wealth); medium. 'sandhim' = peace (7.4), the party not stated.
lines_deva: अर्थ.युक्त्या चलं मित्रं सन्धिं यद् उपगच्छति
तस्य-अपगमने हेतुं विहन्यान् न चलेद् यथा
lines_iast: artha.yuktyā calaṃ mitraṃ sandhiṃ yad upagacchati
tasya-apagamane hetuṃ vihanyān na caled yathā

hindi: या जो शत्रु के साथ साझा होकर रहे, उस शठ को शत्रु से अलग करे, अलग हुए का उच्छेद करे, तब अनन्तर शत्रु को।
english: Or [the ally] which should stand shared with the enemy — that deceitful one [he] should split from the enemy; [when] split, [he] should uproot [that one]; then the enemy next.
notes: 'aritaḥ' read with bhedayet ('from the enemy'); the verb for 'śatrum' (ucchindyāt) is understood. The objects (ally) are neuter in form. śaṭha = deceitful (glossary 9.3). anantaram = next, immediately after.
lines_deva: अरि.साधारणं यद् वा तिष्ठेत् तद् अरितः शठम्
भेदयेद् भिन्नम् उच्छिन्द्यात् ततः शत्रुम् अनन्तरम्
lines_iast: ari.sādhāraṇaṃ yad vā tiṣṭhet tad aritaḥ śaṭham
bhedayed bhinnam ucchindyāt tataḥ śatrum anantaram

hindi: और उदासीन राजा जो ठहरा रहे, उसे सामन्तों से विरुद्ध करे; फिर विग्रह से सन्तप्त को उपकार में लगाए।
english: And the neutral king who should remain — that one [he] should set at odds by the neighbouring chiefs; then, scorched by war, [he] should engage [him] in help.
notes: Neuter 'yat ... tat' agree with 'udāsīnam'. upakāra = help (service). vigraha = war. 'niveśayet' = should engage / settle (put in).
lines_deva: उदासीनं च यत् तिष्ठेत् सामन्तैस् तद् विरोधयेत्
ततो विग्रह.सन्तप्तम् उपकारे निवेशयेत्
lines_iast: udāsīnaṃ ca yat tiṣṭhet sāmantais tad virodhayet
tato vigraha.santaptam upakāre niveśayet

hindi: जो दुर्बल शत्रु और विजिगीषु के पास आता-जाता है, उस पर सेना से अनुग्रह करे जिससे विमुख न हो।
english: The weak one that goes to and fro to the enemy and the conqueror — [he] should favour that one with the army, so that [it] would not be turned away.
notes: Accusatives 'amitram vijigīṣum ca' are read as the goals of 'sañcarati' ('goes to and fro to'). bala = army. parāṅmukha = turned away (averse).
lines_deva: अमित्रं विजिगीषुं च यत् सञ्चरति दुर्बलम्
तद् बलेन-अनुगृह्णीयाद् यथा स्यान् न परान्.मुखम्
lines_iast: amitraṃ vijigīṣuṃ ca yat sañcarati durbalam
tad balena-anugṛhṇīyād yathā syān na parān.mukham

words.gloss: for the reason of favouring the army

hindi: वहाँ से हटाकर दूसरी भूमि में बसाए, या पहले वहाँ दूसरे को बसाकर, सेना पर अनुग्रह के कारण से।
english: Having led [it] away from there, [he] should settle [it] in another land, or, having first settled another there, for the reason of favouring the army.
notes: The grammar of the two lines is loose; the second line ('having first settled another there, for the reason of favouring the army') is left as a dependent clause of the first and may be understood differently. The object (the weak one of unit 38) is not stated. 'vā' at the end of line 1 is rendered 'or'. daṇḍa = army. Reviewer: daṇḍa-anugraha-hetunā may equally mean 'for the reason of favour by means of the army' (cf. kośa-daṇḍābhyām anugṛhṇīyāt, units 8 and 23); both readings are possible.
lines_deva: अपनीय ततो ऽन्यस्यां भूमौ वा सम्निवेशयेत्
निवेश्य पूर्वं तत्र-अन्यद् दण्ड.अनुग्रह.हेतुना
lines_iast: apanīya tato 'nyasyāṃ bhūmau vā samniveśayet
niveśya pūrvaṃ tatra-anyad daṇḍa.anugraha.hetunā

hindi: जो हानि पहुँचाए, या समर्थ होकर आपत्ति में उपकार न करे, उस मित्र का ही उच्छेद करे, जो विश्वास करके गोद के पास आ गया हो।
english: [The ally] which would do harm, or, being capable, would not help in adversity — that ally [he] should uproot indeed, [if it] has trusted and come near [his] lap.
notes: Reading is uncertain (low). 'viśvasya-aṅkam upasthitam' is taken as 'having trusted, come near the lap'; 'aṅka' could also mean 'mark' or 'side'. The e-text's 'tan.mitram' is read as the compound tat-mitra ('that ally') with the pronoun as first member; it could be two words (tat mitram). The 'yat' of line 1 is read as the relative 'which'.
lines_deva: अपकुर्यात् समर्थं वा न-उपकुर्याद् यद् आपदि
उच्छिन्द्याद् एव तन्.मित्रं विश्वस्य-अङ्कम् उपस्थितम्
lines_iast: apakuryāt samarthaṃ vā na-upakuryād yad āpadi
ucchindyād eva tan.mitraṃ viśvasya-aṅkam upasthitam

words.gloss: by one whose calamity is concealed

hindi: या मित्र के व्यसन से जो शत्रु उठ खड़ा हो, जो रोका न जा सके, वह छिपे हुए व्यसन वाले मित्र से ही जीतने योग्य हो।
english: Or the enemy who should rise up because of the ally's calamity, [and who is] unrestrained — he should be overcome only by an ally whose calamity is concealed.
notes: 'anavagraha' = unrestrained / not to be restrained (avagraha = restraint, 7.5). sādhya (gerundive √sādh) = to be overcome (9.7), 'accomplished' possible. vyasana = calamity.
lines_deva: मित्र.व्यसनतो वा-अरिर् उत्तिष्ठेद् यो ऽनवग्रहः
मित्रेण-एव भवेत् साध्यश् छादित.व्यसनेन सः
lines_iast: mitra.vyasanato vā-arir uttiṣṭhed yo 'navagrahaḥ
mitreṇa-eva bhavet sādhyaś chādita.vyasanena saḥ

words.gloss: by success in the enemy's calamity

hindi: शत्रु के व्यसन से उठा हुआ जो मित्र विरक्त हो जाता है, शत्रु के व्यसन की सिद्धि से, उसके शत्रु द्वारा ही, सिद्ध होता है।
english: The ally that, risen because of the enemy's calamity, becomes disaffected — [it] is brought about through success in the enemy's calamity, only by his enemy.
notes: Low confidence: 'prasidhyati' (pra-√sidh/sādh passive, 'is accomplished, is brought about') and the referents of 'tat-śatruṇā' ('by his enemy', the ally's enemy or the enemy in question) are not settled. virajyati = becomes disaffected (virāga = disaffection, 7.5).
lines_deva: अमित्र.व्यसनान् मित्रम् उत्थितं यद् विरज्यति
अरि.व्यसन.सिद्ध्या तत्.शत्रुणा-एव प्रसिध्यति
lines_iast: amitra.vyasanān mitram utthitaṃ yad virajyati
ari.vyasana.siddhyā tat.śatruṇā-eva prasidhyati

hindi: वृद्धि, क्षय और स्थान, तथा क्षीण करना और उच्छेद करना — इन सब उपायों को लगाए, और जो अर्थशास्त्र का ज्ञाता है।
english: Growth, decline and stagnation, likewise weakening and uprooting — all these means [he] should apply, and who is a knower of the Arthashastra.
notes: Syntax uncertain: 'etān' is read with 'sarva-upāyān' ('all these means'), applied to the five states; the dash replaces 'for/to'. 'yaś ca artha-śāstravit' is rendered literally ('and who knows the Arthashastra'); it presumably describes the one who applies the means (so: 'and [so does he] who ...'). kṣaya/sthāna/vṛddhi = decline/stagnation/growth (9.7).
lines_deva: वृद्धिं क्षयं च स्थानं च कर्शन.उच्छेदनं तथा
सर्व.उपायान् समादध्याद् एतान् यश् च-अर्थ.शास्त्रवित्
lines_iast: vṛddhiṃ kṣayaṃ ca sthānaṃ ca karśana.ucchedanaṃ tathā
sarva.upāyān samādadhyād etān yaś ca-artha.śāstravit

words.gram: n. acc. sg., bahuvrīhi (agreeing with ṣāḍguṇyam)

hindi: इस प्रकार जो परस्पर के संचार वाले षाड्गुण्य को देखता है, वह बुद्धि की बेड़ियों से बँधे राजाओं के साथ मनचाहा खेलता है।
english: He who in this way observes the sixfold policy (ṣāḍguṇya) with its mutual movement plays as he wishes with kings bound by the fetters of intellect.
notes: 'buddhi-nigalaiḥ baddhaiḥ' = bound by fetters of intellect (the fetters are his own intellect's, or the kings' bonds); 'iṣṭam' = as desired. anyonya-sañcāra = 'mutual movement' (interplay), literal.
lines_deva: एवम् अन्योन्य.सञ्चारं षाड्गुण्यं यो ऽनुपश्यति
स बुद्धि.निगलैर् बद्धैर् इष्टं क्रीडति पार्थिवैः
lines_iast: evam anyonya.sañcāraṃ ṣāḍguṇyaṃ yo 'nupaśyati
sa buddhi.nigalair baddhair iṣṭaṃ krīḍati pārthivaiḥ
